 Updated Nov. 3, 2026, 10:09 p.m. ET Americans are flocking to the polls in the consequential midterm elections , where control of the House and the Senate is at stake for the remainder of President Donald Trump's second term in office.
Alexander Rudenko, an immigrant from Ukraine, shows an "I Voted" sticker affixed to his Superman costume after casting his ballot on Election Day outside Austin City Hall in Austin, Texas, on Nov. 3, 2026. Rudenko said he supports stricter border security policies and opposes gender-affirming medical treatments for minors. Omar Ornelas / El Paso Times Megan Davidson stands by to collect ballots brought by poll workers at the Beasor B. Walker Law Enforcement Complex in Tuscaloosa, AL, after the polls closed. The votes are tabulated, posted for the public and the paper ballots secured at the facility.
